title: Second Annual Report of the National Science Foundation, 1952
lineage: Inspected indicated passages; local file contains paraphrased research notes.

passages.note: Report pp. 12–13 gives fiscal-year 1952 awards; pp. 21–24 gives fellowships and selection; pp. 50–52 gives research grant proposal and intended payment procedures. Guidance says grants normally went to institutions for specified investigators and required institutional authorization; policy is not proof of payments.
